extracted.intended_audience: general readers, students, researchers, and travelers seeking country/territory reference profiles
extracted.subtask_description: Structured country/territory reference entries (background, geography, population, government, economy, communications, transportation, military, transnational issues) intended to provide standardized factual data and short narrative notes about places.

rubrics_metrics.name: Background
rubrics_metrics.description: Short historical and contextual narrative about the place (e.g., discovery, sovereignty changes, notable events such as volcanic activity or economic development).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides concise historical highlights and salient context (e.g., dates of discovery, sovereignty claims, major events).

rubrics_metrics.name: Location
rubrics_metrics.description: Regional placement description (e.g., 'Northern Europe, island between the Greenland Sea and the Norwegian Sea, northeast of Iceland').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives textual geographic placement relative to regions, seas, or nearby countries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic coordinates
rubrics_metrics.description: Latitude and longitude coordinates (e.g., '71 00 N, 8 00 W').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Exact coordinates for map location; used for georeferencing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Map references
rubrics_metrics.description: Broad map/region reference used for categorization (e.g., 'Arctic Region', 'Asia', 'Oceania').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates the large-scale map or regional grouping for the entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Area (total, land, water)
rubrics_metrics.description: Surface area broken into total, land, and water (e.g., 'total: 373 sq km; water: 0 sq km; land: 373 sq km').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard area metrics for territorial size; numeric values with units.

rubrics_metrics.name: Area - comparative
rubrics_metrics.description: A comparison to a familiar place to give scale (e.g., 'slightly more than twice the size of Washington, DC').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides intuitive size context using well-known reference areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Land boundaries
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of land borders in km (e.g., '0 km').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reports whether territory shares land borders and their extent.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coastline
rubrics_metrics.description: Length of coastline in km (e.g., '124.1 km').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quantifies maritime perimeter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maritime claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Claims to maritime zones and extents (territorial sea, contiguous zone, continental shelf, exclusive economic zone) with numeric distances or depth limits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies legal maritime claim distances (e.g., territorial sea: 4 nm; EEZ: 200 nm; continental shelf: to 200-m depth or to depth of exploitation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Climate
rubrics_metrics.description: General climate classification and notable characteristics (e.g., 'arctic maritime with frequent storms and persistent fog', 'tropical; scant rainfall').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarizes prevailing climate type and typical weather patterns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Terrain
rubrics_metrics.description: Description of physical terrain features (e.g., 'volcanic island, partly covered by glaciers'; 'mostly rugged and mountainous').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short description of dominant landforms and surface characteristics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Elevation extremes
rubrics_metrics.description: Lowest and highest points with names and elevations (e.g., 'lowest point: Norwegian Sea 0 m; highest point: Haakon VII Toppen/Beerenberg 2,277 m').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives elevation range and identifies notable peaks or low points.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural resources
rubrics_metrics.description: List or statement of exploitable natural resources (e.g., 'none', 'negligible mineral resources, fish').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarizes whether there are exploitable natural resources and which ones.

rubrics_metrics.name: Land use
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentages of land devoted to arable land, permanent crops, and other uses (e.g., 'arable land: 0%; permanent crops: 0%; other: 100%').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quantified land use breakdown by category and year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Irrigated land
rubrics_metrics.description: Area of irrigated land (e.g., '0 sq km (1998 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric irrigated land area with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Natural hazards
rubrics_metrics.description: Notable natural hazards affecting the place (e.g., active volcano, persistent storms, narrow fringing reefs, tsunamis, earthquakes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists natural hazard types and brief notes on risks or consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - current issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Contemporary environmental problems or concerns facing the territory (e.g., 'air pollution from power plant emissions results in acid rain', 'no natural fresh water resources').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short description of environmental challenges; may be 'NA' if none listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geography - note
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional geographic remarks or notable features (e.g., 'barren volcanic island with some moss and grass', 'strategic location in northeast Asia').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Free-text supplementary note to elaborate on geographic context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Population / People
rubrics_metrics.description: Total population and notable population characteristics or notes (e.g., 'no indigenous inhabitants; personnel operate the Loran-C base').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives headcount estimates and special population notes or residency context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Age structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Population distribution by age cohorts with male/female breakdowns (e.g., '0-14 years: 14.3% (male ...; female ...), 15-64 years: 66.7% ...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Percentages and sometimes absolute numbers for age groups; year of estimate stated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Median age
rubrics_metrics.description: Median age for total population and by sex (e.g., 'total: 42.3 years; male: 40.5; female: 44.1').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Median age values with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Population growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual population growth rate as a percent (e.g., '0.08% (2004 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Year of estimate included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Birth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual births per 1,000 population (e.g., '9.56 births/1,000 population (2004 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard vital statistics metric with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Death rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Annual deaths per 1,000 population (e.g., '8.75 deaths/1,000 population (2004 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard vital statistics metric with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Net migration rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Net migrants per 1,000 population (e.g., '0 migrant(s)/1,000 population (2004 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates migration contribution to population change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sex ratio
rubrics_metrics.description: Male-to-female ratios at birth and for age groups and total population (e.g., 'total population: 0.96 male(s)/female (2004 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides sex ratio statistics by cohort and overall.

rubrics_metrics.name: Infant mortality rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Infant deaths per 1,000 live births, often split by sex (e.g., 'total: 3.28 deaths/1,000 live births').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard infant mortality metric with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Life expectancy at birth
rubrics_metrics.description: Life expectancy (total, male, female) in years (e.g., 'total population: 81.04 years').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives average expected lifespan at birth with estimate year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total fertility rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Average children born per woman (e.g., '1.38 children born/woman (2004 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard demographic fertility metric with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: HIV/AIDS - adult prevalence rate
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated adult HIV prevalence rate (e.g., 'less than 0.1% (2003 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Public health prevalence estimate with year; may include counts and deaths separately.

rubrics_metrics.name: HIV/AIDS - people living with HIV/AIDS
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated number living with HIV/AIDS (e.g., '12,000 (2003 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Absolute estimate with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: HIV/AIDS - deaths
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated HIV/AIDS deaths (e.g., '500 (2003 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Annual deaths estimate with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nationality (noun/adjective)
rubrics_metrics.description: Terms for people and adjectives denoting nationality (e.g., 'noun: Japanese (singular and plural); adjective: Japanese').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard lexical labels to describe nationals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ethnic groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Breakdown of major ethnic groups and percentages or notable minorities (e.g., 'Japanese 99%, others 1% (Korean 511,262...)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists dominant ethnic constituencies and significant minority counts or percentages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Religions
rubrics_metrics.description: Main religious practices and approximate shares (e.g., 'observe both Shinto and Buddhist 84%, other 16% (including Christian 0.7%)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives religious composition of population.

rubrics_metrics.name: Languages
rubrics_metrics.description: Official and widely used languages (e.g., 'Japanese').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists languages and notes on official status if present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Literacy
rubrics_metrics.description: Definition used and literacy rates by sex and total (e.g., 'definition: age 15 and over can read and write; total population: 99%').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies literacy definition and provides percent estimates with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Country name (conventional long/short)
rubrics_metrics.description: Official conventional long and short forms of the country/territory name (e.g., 'conventional long form: none; conventional short form: Japan').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formal naming conventions used in the entry.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dependency status
rubrics_metrics.description: Political/administrative status (e.g., 'territory of Norway; administered from Oslo...'; 'unincorporated territory of the US').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains sovereignty, administration, or dependent relationship with other states.

rubrics_metrics.name: Government type
rubrics_metrics.description: Form of government (e.g., 'constitutional monarchy with a parliamentary government').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short label of regime type and structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capital
rubrics_metrics.description: Name of capital city (e.g., 'Tokyo').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official seat of government.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary subnational administrative units and examples (e.g., '47 prefectures; Aichi, Akita, ...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists divisions and may include counts and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independence / Historical founding date
rubrics_metrics.description: Date of independence or traditional founding (e.g., '660 BC (traditional founding by Emperor Jimmu)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives formal independence or founding dates where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: National holiday
rubrics_metrics.description: Principal national public holiday with date (e.g., 'Birthday of Emperor AKIHITO, 23 December (1933)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies a key national commemorative day.

rubrics_metrics.name: Constitution
rubrics_metrics.description: Date of constitutional adoption (e.g., '3 May 1947').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the date of the current constitution's adoption.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legal system
rubrics_metrics.description: Type and features of legal system (e.g., 'modeled after European civil law system with English-American influence; judicial review...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarizes legal tradition and notable features like judicial review or ICJ jurisdiction acceptance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Suffrage
rubrics_metrics.description: Voting age/eligibility rules (e.g., '20 years of age; universal').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives age required to vote and whether universal suffrage applies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive branch (chief of state/head of government/cabinet)
rubrics_metrics.description: Key executive offices, how chosen, and current incumbents (e.g., 'chief of state: Emperor AKIHITO; head of government: Prime Minister Junichiro KOIZUMI').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes selection method and, when provided, named office holders with dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Legislative branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Structure of legislature, seat counts, terms, election method, and recent results (e.g., bicameral Diet with House of Councillors and House of Representatives, seat counts and electoral notes).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Details chamber composition, term lengths, electoral systems, and sometimes recent election outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judicial branch
rubrics_metrics.description: Highest courts and method of appointing justices (e.g., 'Supreme Court (chief justice appointed by the monarch after designation by the cabinet; all other justices are appointed by the cabinet)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides structure and appointment process for the judiciary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Political parties and leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: Major political parties and named leaders (e.g., 'Democratic Party of Japan or DPJ [Katsuya OKADA, leader; ...]').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists principal parties and leadership when provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: International organization participation
rubrics_metrics.description: List of international organizations the country participates in (e.g., 'APEC, IMF, WHO, WTO ...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerates multilateral organizations and status (party, member, observer, partner).

rubrics_metrics.name: Diplomatic representation (in the US/from the US)
rubrics_metrics.description: Details on chief of mission, embassy location, consulates, contact info (telephone, fax) for bilateral diplomatic representation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides practical diplomatic contact information and consular presence listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Flag description
rubrics_metrics.description: Textual description of the national flag (e.g., 'white with a large red disk (representing the sun without rays) in the center').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Concise heraldic or pictorial description of flag elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Economy - overview
rubrics_metrics.description: Narrative summary of economic structure, strengths, problems, and notable sectors (e.g., 'Government-industry cooperation... manufacturing groups called keiretsu... aging population and government debt issues').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides an interpretive paragraph summarizing economic context and trends.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP (purchasing power parity and per capita) and growth rate
rubrics_metrics.description: GDP figures in PPP, per capita PPP, and real growth rate (e.g., 'purchasing power parity - $3.582 trillion; real growth rate 2.7%').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key macroeconomic size and growth indicators with year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: GDP - composition by sector
rubrics_metrics.description: Percentage contribution of agriculture, industry, and services to GDP (e.g., 'agriculture: 1.3%; industry: 25.4%; services: 73.3% (2003 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sectoral breakdown of economic activity with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investment (gross fixed)
rubrics_metrics.description: Gross fixed investment as percent of GDP (e.g., '23.9% of GDP (2003)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicator of capital formation share in GDP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Labor force and unemployment
rubrics_metrics.description: Total labor force and unemployment rate (e.g., 'Labor force: 66.66 million (2003)'; 'Unemployment rate: 5.3% (2003)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Labor market size and unemployment metric with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget (revenues/expenditures) and public debt
rubrics_metrics.description: Government revenues and expenditures (including capital expenditures), and public debt as percent of GDP (e.g., 'revenues: $1.327 trillion; expenditures: $1.646 trillion; public debt: 154.6% of GDP').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fiscal position indicators with figures and sometimes capital expenditure detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agriculture - products / Industries
rubrics_metrics.description: Key agricultural products and industrial sectors (e.g., 'rice, sugar beets, vegetables'; 'motor vehicles, electronic equipment, machine tools').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists principal commodities and industrial strengths.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trade (exports/imports, commodities, partners)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total exports/imports values, main export and import commodities, and principal trading partners (e.g., 'Exports: $447.1 billion f.o.b. (2003 est.); exports - commodities: motor vehicles, semiconductors; exports - partners: US 24.8%, China 12.1%').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trade flows and composition with partner-country shares and year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reserves of foreign exchange & gold / Debt - external
rubrics_metrics.description: Reserve holdings and external debt estimates (e.g., 'Reserves: $664.6 billion (2003)'; 'Debt - external: NA (2002 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: External financial position indicators; sometimes 'NA' when unavailable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Currency and exchange rates
rubrics_metrics.description: Name/code of currency and exchange rate examples across years (e.g., 'yen (JPY); yen per US dollar - 115.933 (2003), 125.388 (2002) ...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Currency identification and recent nominal exchange rate history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fiscal year
rubrics_metrics.description: Government fiscal year period (e.g., '1 April - 31 March').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines the accounting year used by the government.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communications - telephones and internet
rubrics_metrics.description: Statistics and qualitative assessment of telephone main lines, mobile cellular, internet hosts/users, ISPs, and telephone system quality (e.g., 'Telephones - main lines in use: 71.149 million (2002); Internet hosts: 12,962,065 (2003)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Quantitative communications infrastructure data and short evaluative comment ('excellent domestic and international service').

rubrics_metrics.name: Radio and television broadcast stations / ownership
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of broadcast stations and repeaters, and number of radios/televisions (e.g., 'AM 215 plus 370 repeaters, FM 89 plus 485 repeaters, shortwave 21 (2001)'; 'Televisions: 86.5 million (1997)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Infrastructure counts and dates of estimates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internet country code / Internet users / Internet hosts
rubrics_metrics.description: Top-level domain, number of internet hosts, ISPs, and estimated internet users (e.g., '.jp; Internet hosts: 12,962,065; Internet users: 57.2 million').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Digital presence metrics with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transportation - railways, highways, waterways, pipelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Quantified transport infrastructure lengths and characteristics (e.g., 'Railways total: 23,705 km (16,519 km electrified)'; 'Highways total: 1,161,894 km').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives network extent and notes on electrification, expressways, or domestic distinctions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ports and harbors / Merchant marine
rubrics_metrics.description: Major port names and merchant fleet size/composition and foreign-registered ships (e.g., list of ports; 'total: 568 ships (1,000 GRT or over) ... foreign-owned: China 1, Panama 1, ...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Infrastructure and fleet statistics with breakdowns by ship type and foreign registration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Airports and runways / Heliports
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of airports, paved and unpaved runways by length categories, and heliports (e.g., 'Airports: 174 (2003 est.)'; 'Airports - with paved runways: total: 143; over 3,047 m: 7').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Runway-length categorization and counts; year of estimate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pipelines (gas, oil, oil/gas/water)
rubrics_metrics.description: Lengths of pipelines for gas, oil, and combined uses (e.g., 'gas 2,719 km; oil 170 km; oil/gas/water 60 km (2004)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Infrastructure pipeline lengths with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military - branches
rubrics_metrics.description: Names or structure of military branches (e.g., 'Ground Self-Defense Force (Army), Maritime Self-Defense Force (Navy), Air Self-Defense Force (Air Force), Coast Guard').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists main defense components; sometimes notes defense responsibility for territories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military manpower - military age and obligation
rubrics_metrics.description: Minimum age and whether service is voluntary or conscription (e.g., '18 years of age for voluntary military service; younger recruits may be conscripted with parental consent (2001)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies age thresholds and conscription/volunteer status with year when provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military manpower - availability / fit for military service / reaching military age annually
rubrics_metrics.description: Counts of males in age bands for availability and fitness and annual numbers reaching military age (e.g., 'males age 15-49: 29,179,095; fit for service: 25,189,438; reaching military age annually: 700,931 (2004 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demographic metrics relevant to recruitment potential with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military expenditures - dollar figure and percent of GDP
rubrics_metrics.description: Defense spending in absolute dollar terms and as percent of GDP (e.g., '$42,488.1 million (2003); 1% (2003)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fiscal burden of defense expressed in two common ways with year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transnational Issues - disputes and illicit activities
rubrics_metrics.description: International disputes, transshipment/illicit drug concerns, money-laundering and corruption notes (e.g., 'major transshipment point for cocaine; corruption is a major concern').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists outstanding international disputes and cross-border criminal/illicit activity concerns relevant to foreign relations or security.

rubrics_metrics.name: Disputes - international
rubrics_metrics.description: Statement of international sovereignty disputes or 'none' if none exist (e.g., 'none'; detailed dispute descriptions for contested territories).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Short declarative entry indicating whether notable disputes exist, with a brief elaboration when present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Environment - international agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: Treaties and international environmental agreements the country is party to (e.g., 'party to: Antarctic-Environmental Protocol, Biodiversity, Climate Change-Kyoto Protocol, ...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enumerates environmental multilateral commitments and participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Population notes / special residency
rubrics_metrics.description: Notes about non-indigenous inhabitants, personnel presence, or access restrictions (e.g., 'no indigenous inhabitants; personnel operate the Loran-C base and the weather and coastal services radio station').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contextual notes clarifying why population exists or is absent and special-use permit access restrictions when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Last updated
rubrics_metrics.description: Date the page/entry was last updated (e.g., 'This page was last updated on 10 February, 2005').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates currency of the presented data and narrative.
